public function parse_command(arguments: List of Text) returns Command
  purpose: Turn command-line words into a command; anything unrecognized is Help.
  example: parse_command(["add", "buy", "milk"]) is Add(task: "buy milk")
  example: parse_command(["done", "2"]) is Done(position: 2)
  example: parse_command([]) is Help

  let verb be arguments.first() otherwise return Help
  let words be arguments.rest()
  if verb is "add" then
    if words.is_empty() then
      return Help
    end
    return Add(task: words.join(" "))
  otherwise if verb is "done" then
    let number_text be words.first() otherwise return Help
    let number be number_text.to_integer() otherwise return Help
    let command be Done(position: number) otherwise return Help
    return command
  otherwise if verb is "show" then
    return Show
  end
  return Help
end
```

```
public function parse_command(arguments: List of Text) returns Command
  purpose: Turn command-line words into a command; anything unrecognized is Help.
  example: parse_command(["add", "buy", "milk"]) is Add(task: "buy milk")
  example: parse_command(["done", "2"]) is Done(position: 2)
  example: parse_command([]) is Help

  let verb be arguments.first() otherwise return Help
  let words be arguments.rest()
  if verb is "add" then
    let task be words.join(" ")
    if task.trim().is_empty() then
      return Help
    end
    return Add(task: task)
  otherwise if verb is "done" then
    let text be words.first() otherwise return Help
    let number be text.to_integer() otherwise return Help
    if number is less than 1 then
      return Help
    end
    return Done(position: number)
  otherwise if verb is "show" then
    return Show
  otherwise
    return Help
  end
end
```

```
public function parse_command(arguments: List of Text) returns Command
  purpose: Turn command-line words into a command; anything unrecognized is Help.
  example: parse_command(["add", "buy", "milk"]) is Add(task: "buy milk")
  example: parse_command(["done", "2"]) is Done(position: 2)
  example: parse_command([]) is Help

  let command be arguments.first() otherwise return Help
  let words be arguments.rest()
  if command is "add" then
    if words.is_empty() then
      return Help
    end
    return Add(task: words.join(" "))
  otherwise if command is "done" then
    let word be words.first() otherwise return Help
    let position be word.to_integer() otherwise return Help
    let finished be Done(position: position) otherwise return Help
    return finished
  otherwise if command is "show" then
    return Show
  otherwise
    return Help
  end
end
